title: Shein Set for Long-Awaited Hong Kong IPO Debut
summary: From a peak valuation of 100 billion dollars to a targeted debut at a fraction of that figure, ultra-fast fashion giant Shein is preparing for a long-awaited public listing. But as regulatory crackdowns close tax loopholes and squeeze profit margins, the digital retailer is being forced to radically remake its business model. Bloomberg’s Minmin Low reports from Hong Kong. (Corrects spelling of the company's name in the headline.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dollar Debasement Trade Will Boost Emerging Bonds, Funds Say

title: Ten-Month Rift Keeps the Nasdaq Short of a Record
summary: The S&P 500 closed the book on the summer selloff about a month ago and went back to setting records. The Nasdaq 100 is still tallying the bill for the season. The outstanding balance is small, but the insights it offers on this market are not.

title: War, Weather Push Crop Prices to Biggest Monthly Gain Since 2012
summary: Crop prices are set to cap their biggest monthly jump in more than a decade as wars and extreme weather disrupt supplies, raising concerns about food inflation.

title: Stocks, Gold Drop on Fed Rate-Hike Bets; Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
summary: Global stocks and gold retreated as hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh fueled bets on an interest-rate hike next month. Oil climbed as Middle East tensions flared.

title: Goldman Sachs Steps Up Warnings on Diesel as Wars Curb Flows
summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. stepped up warnings of tightness in global refining driven by wars in the Middle East and between Moscow and Kyiv, with the bank more than doubling its forecasts for profits from making diesel.

title: Grand Canyon Flash Flood Leaves One Dead, 15 Others Missing
summary: At least one person died and 15 others may be missing or unaccounted for after a flash flood in the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service said Sunday.

title: China Coking Coal Heads for Record Monthly Gain on Supply Crunch
summary: Chinese coking coal prices were heading for the biggest monthly gain on record, as supply of the steelmaking raw material tightens on the back of output disruptions and tougher safety checks.

title: Inflation Control Good for US Growth: L&G Strategist
summary: L&G Asia Head of Investment Strategy Ben Bennett describes Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's latest Jackson Hole speech as "pragmatic," noting that controlling inflation will benefit US economic expansion. He speaks as analysts project the central bank may be poised to raise interest rates.   (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s August LNG Imports Set to Drop as High Prices Hit Demand
summary: China’s imports of liquefied natural gas are set to drop this month from a year earlier, according to ship-tracking data, as higher prices triggered by the war in the Middle East weighed on consumption.

title: Sungrow Shares Slump After Profit Tumbles by Almost a Third
summary: The shares of Sungrow Power Supply Co., one of the world’s biggest renewable energy equipment makers, tumbled after the Chinese company reported a sharp drop in first-half profit.

title: Bond Investors Wary After Warsh Speech Fuels Rate-Hike Bets
summary: Bond investors at firms including ABN AMRO Investment Solutions and Brandywine Global Investment Management are voicing skepticism about mounting speculation that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is poised to raise interest rates.

title: Radiant World’s Senior China Trader Quits as Pressure Builds
summary: A leading executive at Radiant World’s China office has quit, according to sources familiar with the matter, as the iron ore trader comes under pressure over concerns it provided falsified documents to banks.

title: India Share Sale Pipeline Swells as Firms Rush to Raise Funds
summary: Indian listed companies are ramping up equity offerings to institutional investors as ample liquidity and improving sentiment open a window for one of the fastest routes to raise funds.
